description: Drip irrigation systems in Kenya for kitchen gardens, greenhouses and commercial farms. Compare driplines, filters, fittings and complete kits with DripTech support.
h1: Drip irrigation systems for Kenyan farms
intro: Drip irrigation delivers water close to the crop root zone, helping farmers manage water, pressure and fertiliser more precisely. DripTech supplies the parts and complete systems needed for small plots, greenhouses and larger farms across Kenya.

sections.heading: Choose the right system for your crop and plot
paragraphs: The right layout depends on the crop spacing, field shape, water source, available pressure and the number of beds. We help you choose the dripline, filter, fittings, valves and pump capacity before you buy.

For vegetables and other row crops, emitter spacing and flow rate matter as much as the length of the roll. A system sized for the actual beds is easier to operate and maintain than a one-size-fits-all package.

sections.heading: Get help before you order
paragraphs: Send the crop, acreage, water source and a photo or sketch of the field on WhatsApp. DripTech can help you build a practical parts list or arrange installation support.
Browse the current catalogue for available equipment, then contact the team when you need help matching products to your farm.

title: Drip Irrigation Kit Prices in Kenya | Compare Kits | DripTech
description: Compare drip irrigation kits in Kenya by plot size, crop and components. See current catalogue prices and get help choosing driplines, filters, fittings and installation support.
h1: Drip irrigation kit prices in Kenya
intro: A useful drip irrigation kit price depends on more than acreage. Crop spacing, number of drip lines per bed, water pressure, filtration and whether installation is included all affect the final system.

sections.heading: What a complete drip kit normally includes
bullets: Mainline and submain pipe sized for the field
Driplines or drip tape matched to crop spacing
A filter and pressure-control components
Connectors, valves, end caps and fittings
A water source connection or pump recommendation where needed

sections.heading: Why prices differ between farms
paragraphs: A kitchen garden, greenhouse and one-acre open field do not need the same number of lines or the same pressure capacity. The crop also changes the row spacing and emitter requirement.

Use the catalogue to compare the current products and kit options. For a complete farm price, share the plot size, crop, water source and location so the bill of materials is sized instead of guessed.

sections.heading: Ask for a practical quote
paragraphs: DripTech supports farmers across Kenya with equipment selection, delivery and installation coordination. A clear quote should show the kit size, included components, installation scope and any items still required at the farm.

title: Driplines for Sale in Kenya | Drip Tape & Emitters | DripTech
description: Buy driplines, drip tape and emitters in Kenya for vegetables, greenhouse crops and open-field farms. Compare spacing, flow and supporting fittings from DripTech.
h1: Driplines and drip tape for sale in Kenya
intro: Driplines are the part of a drip system that places water beside the crop. The correct spacing, wall thickness, flow rate and filtration determine how evenly the field receives water.

sections.heading: Choose spacing for the crop
paragraphs: Common row-crop choices include 15 cm, 20 cm and 30 cm emitter spacing. Closely planted vegetables may need closer emitters, while wider-spaced crops can use a different layout.
The best selection also depends on the bed width, line length, operating pressure and water quality. DripTech can help check those details before you order a roll.

sections.heading: Do not forget the supporting parts
bullets: A suitable filter to protect emitters from blockage
Take-off connectors, grommets and end caps
Mainline and submain pipe
Pressure regulation and flush points
A pump or elevated tank connection when required

sections.heading: Shop the current range
paragraphs: Browse the live drip category for available driplines, emitters, connectors and related products. Product pages include the information available for the current stock item and provide a direct route to ask about delivery or installation.

title: Sprinkler Systems in Kenya | Farm Sprinklers & Installation | DripTech
description: Sprinkler systems in Kenya for farms, nurseries and open fields. Compare sprinklers, rain guns, pipes, pumps and fittings with sizing and installation support.
h1: Sprinkler systems for farms in Kenya
intro: Sprinklers are useful when a farm needs broader coverage than a row-based drip system. The correct sprinkler depends on the crop, application rate, operating pressure, spacing and available water supply.

sections.heading: Sprinklers for different farm layouts
paragraphs: A small plot, nursery, greenhouse perimeter and open field may each require a different sprinkler pattern. Sprinkler spacing should be planned around the throw, wind exposure and the crop's water requirement.
DripTech supplies sprinkler equipment and related pipes, pumps, valves and fittings. The team can help compare a sprinkler layout with drip irrigation when both options could work.

sections.heading: What to check before buying
bullets: Available water flow and operating pressure
Required coverage and sprinkler spacing
Pipe diameter and run length
Pump capacity and power source
Drainage, wind and crop sensitivity

sections.heading: Get the system sized for your farm
paragraphs: Share the field size, crop, water source and location for a more useful recommendation. DripTech can supply the equipment and coordinate installation support across Kenya.
